title: Week 4 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “ratification”?
options: Direct communication with public officials intended to influence decisions.
Authority granted to local governments to manage local affairs.
Formal approval of a constitution, treaty, or amendment.
A system limiting total emissions and allowing permits to be traded.
questions.explanation: Ratification means formal approval of a constitution, treaty, or amendment.
